sources: https://www.roverpass.com/c/sula-country-store-resort-sula-mt (the operator's own booking engine, linked from its BOOK RV SITE button; 'Last Updated: 10/21/2026'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.sulacamping.com/ ('5 Full Hook-Up (30 amp) Pull-Through', '2 Full Hook-Up (50 amp) Pull-Through', '12 Partial Hook-Up (30 amp) Back-'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: The operator says 18 RV sites, though its list adds up to 19: 7 full-hookup pull-throughs (two of them 50-amp) and 12 back-in water/electric sites. Tents pay the RV-site price.

sites.source: https://www.sulacamping.com/ ('We offer 18 Rv sites'; site list as above) + https://www.roverpass.com/c/sula-country-store-resort-sula-mt ('you are welcome to tent camp but prices are the same as an Rv site'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Bathhouse for guests on the non-sewer sites and dry cabins, with water year-round. No laundry (staff may do a load for a fee). General store with grab-and-go food, 24/7 pay-at-pump fuel.

facilities.source: https://www.roverpass.com/c/sula-country-store-resort-sula-mt ('We offer clean bathhouse for guests who use our non sewer Rv sites', 'Currently there are no laundry facilities', amenities 'Shower', 'Dump Station') + https://www.sulacamping.com/ (general store, '24/7 Pay at pump fuel'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: RV park opens May 15 (weather permitting) and closes November 30; the booking calendar shows May 12 - November 30. Water at the RV sites is shut off October 1 for winterization. Cabins stay open in winter.

season.source: https://www.sulacamping.com/ ('Water shuts off at all Rv sites October 1st - Rv park closes Nov 30th until May') + https://www.roverpass.com/c/sula-country-store-resort-sula-mt ('The Rv park opens May 15th (weather permitting) for the season', 'Open Dates: May 12 to November 30'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 'We do have a 2 night minimum on all cabins, Rv & tent sites.' Some sites are Instant Book, others need campground approval. $20 fee on a cancellation that qualifies for a deposit refund.

booking.source: https://www.sulacamping.com/book-now ('We do have a 2 night minimum on all cabins, Rv & tent sites') + https://www.roverpass.com/c/sula-country-store-resort-sula-mt ('a two night minimum stay is required', Instant Book note), read 2026-10-22

values.note: $48 a night for a 30-amp full-hookup pull-through or 30-amp water/electric back-in, $53 for 50-amp full hookups (tent sites also $53). Weekly and monthly rates offered. Pet and extra-vehicle fees apply.

fees.source: https://www.roverpass.com/c/sula-country-store-resort-sula-mt (Rates, 'Last Updated: 10/21/2026': Full Hookups (30 Amps) - Pull Through $48.00, Full Hookups (50 Amps) - Pull Through $53.00, Partial Hookups (30 Amps) - Back In $48.00 starting daily), read 2026-10-22

note: Private RV park on US-93 at Sula, beside the East Fork of the Bitterroot; over 100 years old, with cabins as well. --Claude
summary: Operator site + its RoverPass booking engine: confirmed 18 RV sites, water hookups, store, dump. Added 50-amp full hookups (sewer), pull-throughs, showers, no laundry, season May 15 - Nov 30 (water off Oct 1), RoverPass booking with a standing 2-night minimum, $48-53/night (updated 10/21/2026). Discounts not stated (left). Note trimmed of restated values.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: the operator says 'Our property lies along the beautiful Bitterroot River', 'East Fork of the Bitterroot River – Flowing right alongside Camp Sula' and lists 'River access on site'; the entry says not waterfront.
Standing 2-night minimum on every site, every night ('We do have a 2 night minimum on all cabins, Rv & tent sites').
